es.positioning: El socio SEO honesto y claro para pequeñas empresas: explicamos lo que hacemos, lo medimos y nunca vendemos posiciones.

taglines: Que te encuentren en Google, sin humo.
Tener web no es salir en Google. Que te encuentren, sí.

es.heroLead: Posicionamiento SEO para pequeñas empresas de España y Latinoamérica: auditoría, SEO local, técnico, contenidos y visibilidad en ChatGPT y Google IA. Te explicamos cada paso con palabras normales y no te prometemos puestos que nadie puede garantizar.

problem.title: Tener web no es salir en Google. Que te encuentren, sí.
points: Tu web no aparece cuando te buscan
Visitas que no se convierten en llamadas
Nadie te explica qué se ha hecho

not: Gurú / hype («¡primero en Google en 30 días!»)
Barata o con pinta de plantilla

tone.why: Como mucho un término técnico por frase, explicado la primera vez («indexar = que Google guarde tu página»).
Ni rankings garantizados ni cifras de tráfico; los ejemplos van marcados «ejemplo ilustrativo».

doDont.do: Te decimos qué falla en tu web y en qué orden arreglarlo.
El SEO tarda meses. Te enseñamos cada mes qué ha cambiado.
Ejemplo ilustrativo: tu web sube de la #9 a la #1.

en.positioning: The honest, plain-spoken SEO partner for small businesses: we explain what we do, measure it and never sell positions.
en.promise: Get found on Google, without the hype.
taglines: Get found on Google, without the hype.
Having a website isn't being on Google. Being found is.
SEO takes months. We show you what's changed every month.
en.heroLead: SEO for small businesses in Spain and Latin America: audits, local, technical and content SEO, plus visibility in ChatGPT and Google AI. We explain every step in plain words and never promise positions nobody can guarantee.

problem.title: Having a website isn't being on Google. Being found is.
points: Your site doesn't show up when people search for you
Visits that never turn into calls
problem.answer: We sort it out step by step

tone.why: At most one technical term per sentence, explained the first time («indexing = Google saving your page»).
We review, We fix, We measure.
No guaranteed rankings or traffic figures; examples are labelled «illustrative example».

doDont.do: We tell you what's wrong with your site and in what order to fix it.
SEO takes months. Every month we show you what's changed.
Ask for your free SEO audit.
Illustrative example: your site climbs from #9 to #1.
doDont.dont: We'll get you to #1 on Google.

en.socialLine: Google and AI search rankings for small businesses

rules: Never promise positions, guaranteed rankings or traffic figures.

openQuestions: CMYK and Pantone values are screen-to-print estimates: ask the printer for a colour proof.
Legal name: kit uses "HS Digital Solutions LTD" as confirmed by the owner (2026-11-13); the site settings note the UK Ltd was reverted. Check before printing legal documents.
Offices: the sites only say «Atendemos en Madrid y Bilbao»; the kit shows the two addresses as confirmed by the owner.
The site lockup SVGs (in source/) are not set in Bricolage Grotesque; the kit redraws every lockup in Bricolage. Update the sites to the kit logos.
Favicons, app icon and accent avatar are Navy tiles with a white + accent mark (the owner chose this over full accent tiles, 2026-11-13); the plain two-tone mark is kept as icons/favicon-mark.svg.
